description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageMappingStrategies' that provides helper methods for mapping 'Adaptable' objects to 'Message' objects and their headers, including message creation, header extraction, and status code retrieval. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter.adaptables' package and references various classes related to messaging, headers, JSON, and signals within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractMessageMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods for converting 'Adaptable' objects into 'Message' objects, extracting headers, and retrieving status codes within the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework.

methods.name: messageFrom
methods.description: Creates a 'Message' object from an 'Adaptable', deserializing headers and payload, and constructing the message with additional data.

methods.name: messageHeadersFrom
methods.description: Extracts and constructs 'MessageHeaders' from an 'Adaptable', including setting headers like 'thingId', 'subject', 'direction', 'featureId', and 'statusCode'.

methods.name: statusCodeFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the 'HttpStatusCode' from an 'Adaptable' payload, throwing an exception if absent.
